g.text: Wiring 2 · Kitronik terminals to the PiicoDev chain (B7 cable)

text.style: font-size: 18px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #3d4f66

g.text: Four B7 conductors (W13a–d) join the Kitronik GND, 3V, GP0 and GP1 terminals to the first module.

g.text: Logical map: box layout and pin order are NOT the physical terminal order. Read the printed labels on the delivered parts. Pip v0.3 · illustrations/wiring.py

g.text: The 3V terminal is the Pico's 3V3 OUT. Its capacity is not stated; the Pico datasheet recommends under 300 mA (PG6, WO6).

g.text: Never connect 5 V to a GPIO terminal or to the PiicoDev chain.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15.12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #14305a

g.text: Future firmware must set I2C0 to GP0 (SDA) and GP1 (SCL); the PiicoDev library defaults to GP8 and GP9. First scan at 100 kHz

text.style: font-size: 15.12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; fill: #14305a

g.text: only; the OLED driver recommends at least 400 kHz later (FUTURE).
